text: For quadratic maps f_c(z) = z^2 + c, the Mandelbrot set is the set of parameters c for which:
choices: the orbit of the critical point 0 remains bounded
f_c has exactly one fixed point
explanation: Membership is decided by the critical orbit: c is in M iff the forward orbit of 0 stays bounded, equivalently the Julia set is connected. It is not restricted to real c and Julia sets are never empty for these maps.
